name: Namaste Farmer
description: A bio-fertilizer product that is fully soluble in soil, formulated to naturally boost crop yield and revive dormant nutrients so the soil's fertilizing power keeps improving over time. Intended as an agricultural soil input to support healthier, stronger crops.
benefits: A bio-fertilizer product that is completely soluble in soil

usage: Low-input crops (paddy, wheat, mustard, Parmal rice, Katila, sorghum fodder/Chari, pearl millet/Bajra, and all types of animal fodder, etc.): use 1 kg per acre
